beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Brand occupied proportionally more width; inherited brown football/decorative repetition and harsh striping competed with stadium depth.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: Original diamond/gold/money-bag artwork remains crisp at compact width over a blue stadium. Black/blue luminosity outside panels removes green-field repeats; only the featured game contains a green pitch. Shared Home image files are unchanged.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Materially closer to the approved top hierarchy; actual brand imagery retained rather than replaced.

beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Shield was small inside a plain blue disc. Generic rounded child SELECT rendered taller than the intended wrapper.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: Genuine local NFL SVG fills the mechanical multi-ring medallion; contained angular week control aligns beside broad NFL lettering and sourced season/context. Both native browser tops show the same correct anatomy.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Accepted: no child overflow, logo stretching or clipped factual labels.

beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Basic rounded silhouettes and thin generic bright faces; inherited flex geometry shifted selected width.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: Three equal grid columns carry nested chamfered skins, independent cobalt selected faces and readable local block type. Official conference marks and blue/gold continuous rail preserve the reference control grouping.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Accepted: stable geometry and matching hierarchy without false sample data.

beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Small AFC mark and narrow Anton heading started too far left; SELECT widgets retained generic native styling.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: Enlarged official AFC mark and broader title begin near the source horizontal proportion. Three compact selectors sit fully within distinct chamfered wrappers, with no pixelated art or label bleed.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Accepted at 393 and 430 in Chromium and WebKit.

beforeAfterSectionNotes.section: Standings rows, team summary and View 16
beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Heavy narrow typography, basic rounded details and two-diamond action; corner stickers and stripes competed with dense rows.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: Nine aligned columns, clean body weights, one-line Team details and contained form chips keep real Pittsburgh rank 9 and verified results. Full panel hardware no longer covers table ink. Four faceted diamonds bracket the broad cobalt View all 16 teams action.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Accepted. Source concept rank/order/value differences are intentionally retained as verified real data.

beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Broad squat helmets consumed center field, short labels and dominant stripes flattened the reference composition.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: Undistorted native 1254-square equipment presentation is taller and reveals wider central pitch. Independent genuine team badges remain entirely on blank helmet shell. Gold/ice condensed wordmarks, metallic italic VS, framed stadium and six crystals restore the source hierarchy.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Accepted as materially closer equipment composition; exact raster gear pose is not identical to the attachment.

beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Generic rounded blue/gold buttons and inconsistent text arrow glyphs.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: Angular View matchup/Compare teams/Team form controls keep readable text and native SVG chevrons. Verified date/time/venue occupy a compact line rather than being removed to imitate illustrative source metadata.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Accepted: readable at native bottom, with no control or icon clipping.

beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Overly condensed heavy names/headings, strong repeated diagonal backgrounds, narrow generic edge and corner sticker overlap risks.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: All three compact leader cards use broader block headings, lighter local body typography, aligned rank/name/yards/TD columns and nested hardware. Personally inspected untouched bottom PNGs show all fifteen rows, rank 5 and TD glyphs visible in both browsers.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Accepted: crisp rows and stable density; verified receiving leaders remain different from the illustrative concept.

beforeAfterSectionNotes.before: Longer page silhouette, noisy outside background and basic rounded nav hardware.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.after: NFL retains exactly the Home-sized enclosure and internal scrolling. Fixed nav/footer stay inside the frame, while untouched native bottoms show all lower content above navigation. Full sheets are qualified isolated-page exposures; the original functional phone receives no substitutions.
beforeAfterSectionNotes.assessment: Accepted: no document/table horizontal overflow, clipped control or hidden final leader row.
